scope: Actual pinned ELF32/ELF64 file and section header construction

verification.targeted_tests: All nine linux::module_elf tests passed, including byte comparisons for every generated header case.

limitations: Full native module reconstruction still accepts only 64-bit Intel symbols; ELF32 symbol normalization and full-file reconstruction are not implemented by this batch.
The pinned reference keeps sh_entsize=24 for .rela.* on both architectures and treats .rel.* as ordinary PROGBITS; the vectors preserve those behaviors.

ELF32 section address, length and file-offset overflows are compared against the actual reference None result without allocating oversized section payloads. File-header offset/count overflows record the reference struct.error separately; both failure forms map to native Result::Err rather than reproducing Python exception objects.
No real Linux32 image or full plugin contract is established.
